ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION RESULT: probes and design SUSTAINED. Every independently re-derived headline number reproduced; all code citations are real; one load-bearing caveat/prerequisite (the plies-vs-decisions unit ambiguity) is REFUTED by direct measurement — in the direction FAVORABLE to feasibility — plus three smaller wording/logic corrections. Nothing changes the verdicts (m4c12 head unusable; healthy heads coarse-only; mechanism safe; CONDITIONAL GO with head-heal gate).

1. PARAMETERIZATION CHECK (would invalidate everything if misread) — CORRECT. Verified line-by-line: MOVES_LEFT_CAP=512 (constants.py:27), changed 80->512 in commit f80009b dated 2026-06-10 15:23 (git show confirms the literal diff); normalization 2*min(1,ml/512)-1 at samples.py:280; target = len(decisions)-index-1, 0 at final decision, -1 mask for truncated (samples.py:134-136, 240) — formula unchanged since the head landed (80c48cc, 2026-06-09) so ALL audited ckpts trained under one convention; loss = binned_value_loss over 65 bins with scalar_to_binned_target adjacent-bin soft labels, moves_left_weight=0.1 at exactly losses.py:142, masked rows contribute nothing (losses.py:166-173); head = Linear(64->65) on the SHARED aux ValueReduction (architecture.py:773-778, 849-854), Conv1x1+Linear(1681->64) as the design states (architecture.py:664-682); absent from forward_policy_value (architecture.py:857-864); 65 bins over [-1,1] -> bin width 8 decisions at cap 512. VALUE_BINS=65 confirmed.

2. INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATIONS (fresh computations, different positions/games):
(a) Fresh NN audit (scripts/_wf_s3v_freshaudit.py -> _wf_s3v_freshaudit_out.txt): 20 m3ep5 decisive games chosen RANDOMLY (seed 20260612), explicitly EXCLUDING the probe's 60 length-stratified linspace indices; 3 ckpts, CPU, full training forward. Results replicate the probe within noise: m3c7 conv(<60) rho 0.624 (probe 0.609), [0,5) median-decode MAE 9.9 n=100 (probe 13.3), [5,20) 30.2 (32.4), [20,60) 30.0 (29.0), end-vs-mid pairwise 0.910 n=13 games (0.872), end-drop 1.000; m3c5: 0.619 / 10.9 / 0.870; m4c12 ON THE SAME HEALTHY GAMES: conv rho 0.122 (probe 0.087), pairwise 0.516 = chance (probe 0.487), [0,5) MAE 39.2, [5,20) 69.6 — the flood-damage collapse (m3c5-vs-m4c12 before/after on identical-distribution games) replicates decisively.
(b) Dawdle probe (scripts/_wf_s3v_rederive.py): recomputed ALL headline stats from the RAW per-candidate evals in _wf_s3d_probe_out.json, ignoring the stored per_k/summary blocks. Exact matches: squander flips 3/64 (4.7%) @k=0.05 and 0.1, 8/64 (12.5%) @0.2, 19/64 (29.7%) @0.5, 35/64 (54.7%) @1.0; games hit 4/8 @0.2, 8/8 @0.5; control flips 0/15 at ALL k through 1.0; midgame 0/24 at k<=0.5, 2/24 (8.3%) @1.0; critical-k median 0.832; near-v spread median 5.51 IQR 4.22-7.79 max 21.83; played-above-median-ml 42/64; leader_won 31/64 (48%); v-gap best-to-2nd median 0.0021, v-range 0.0253, n_near median 12; parity structure exactly 26 turn-passing (wholesale sign flip) / 38 mid-chain (sign kept) / 0 parity-mixed positions, stm_next uniform in all 79; terminal candidates 0; control v-gap median 0.065; cross-move ml jump +24.9 per-candidate median (reported +25).
(c) Training-loss trajectories re-read from run-dir diagnostics JSONs: main_3 3.33/3.12/3.31/3.29/3.15/3.18/3.20/3.47/3.89/3.94 (ep1-10), main_4 3.19/3.22/3.39/3.56/3.65/3.53/3.48/3.36 (ep6-13) — match all quoted values incl. the goal's 3.153->3.203 ep5-7 rise.
(d) Sibling probe aggregates recomputed from _wf_s3_sibling_out.json raw: m3c7 decrements +14.23/+6.35/+3.72 at ml=10/30/60, sib std ~4.8-5.2, range 18.1-19.8; m4c12 -3.66/-19.09 at ml=30/60 (wrong sign) — all as reported (n=12/cell, high per-position variance consistent with the disclosed caveat).
(e) main_4 manifest: initialize_from = main_3/checkpoints/epoch_000005.pt — lineage claim confirmed.
(f) npz shards (ALL rows, all shards, not the probe's 8000-row sample): ep5 19,136 rows, masked 1.26%, mean 75.6, >512 0.20%; ep9 37,408 rows, masked 4.20%, mean 164.8, max 860, >512 2.64% — consistent with the probe's quoted per-shard numbers.

3. UNIT-AMBIGUITY CLAIM REFUTED (the one substantive error; favorable direction). The dawdle-probe caveat and design L0(1)/risk bullet claim npz moves_left is "plies-like (ml + turn_index = game length exactly, max 853)" implying a possible ~2x decisions-vs-plies mismatch requiring resolution AND head retraining before enablement. Direct measurement: for 100% of unmasked rows in both ep5 and ep9 shard sets, ml + turn_index == L - 1 for some decisive .hxr game length L in the union of source epochs (frac sum==L-1: 1.0000 union, 0.89 own-epoch — shuffleddata mixes an epoch window, which also explains npz max 860 > own-epoch .hxr max 855; NOT a unit difference). This is EXACTLY the current samples.py convention (decisions-remaining-AFTER, per placement). In this pipeline "decisions" = placements = .hxr actions: finalize runs over the DENSE trajectory including fast/init moves (selfplay.py:912-916 "Finalize over the DENSE pending trajectory"), rows filtered to full-search only afterwards. So npz target units == .hxr replay units == proposed Rust tree-edge depth-offset units. No mismatch, no retraining-for-units, no 2x risk. The audit probe's own parameterization section already had this right; only the dawdle caveat + design L0/risk are wrong.

4. RUST/PYTHON INSERTION POINTS — ALL REAL AND ACCURATELY CITED. mcts_tree.rs: RustEdge :47 (visits/value_sum/pending/forced), RustNode :126, select_or_materialize_edge :577 with the visited-edge PUCT score at exactly :609 (value_or_fpu + prior*scale/(1+visits)), staged materialization branch :627, forced_root_edge :662 (untouched), apply_virtual_visit :691 (subtracts virtual_loss from value_sum -> the keep-ml-out-of-virtual-visits rationale is accurate), backup_virtual :703 with value_sum += at :718-719 (perspective negation per node player confirmed -> the design's "ml perspective-free, value negated" split is coherent). mcts.rs: batch backup call sites :1301-1331 (terminal :1304, existing_node :1307, TSS verdict :1321, NN leaf push :1324), apply_eval_backups :1352-1369, continuous :1391-1411, backup_continuous_items :1465-1494, visit_policy :2132-2159 (final move selection IS visit-based; selection-time bonus suffices), pruned_visit_policy :2179, prune_forced_delta_counts :2226 (recomputes PUCT WITHOUT ml from deltas/priors/values — the design's documented phase-1 inconsistency claim is exactly right), PyO3 run_continuous signature at exactly :684 with Option-typed trailing args pattern confirmed. mcts_eval.rs: RustEvaluation :102-112 (value + priors, Arc-shared), parse site :339-390 (values_bytes/priors_bytes required keys, require_exact_bytes(rows,4)), read_value :609 (finite + range rejection — the proposed read_moves_left mirror is apt). Python: evaluate_model1_payload inference.py:337-412 with chunked concat :356-361 and 2-key return contract :409-412; _adopt_fp16_model :414+; config.py PCR knobs :223-235, [selfplay] parse region :442-456, unknown-key rejection (_reject_unknown :509) exists as claimed; mcts.py:135 and rust_bridge.py:102 are the cited plumbing surfaces; TRT and torch.compile graphs are genuinely built on forward_policy_value (trt_backend.py:45/345, compile_backend.py:132) so L5's refuse-adoption phase-1 is grounded; cargo-test infra exists (22 #[test]/#[cfg(test)] across mcts.rs/mcts_tree.rs).

5. DESIGN CALIBRATION ARITHMETIC — CHECKS OUT. Probe band k in [0.2,0.5] on U=v-k*sgn(v)*ml/512 = per-decision slope 3.91e-4..9.77e-4; design small-delta slope w_ml*g/m_scale = 4.69e-4 at |Q|=0.8 (g=0.5, ~k=0.24) and 9.38e-4 at g=1 (~k=0.48) — inside the envelope as claimed. m_scale=32 = 4 bins at width 8 ✓. The probe's absolute-ml form is argmax-equivalent to the delta-vs-node-baseline form within a node (per-position constant cancels), and tanh saturation is strictly conservative, so the calibration transfer is sound. Backup depth-offset arithmetic: leaf_ml + (path_len - i) is EXACT for NN leaves and existing-node leaves under the after-decision convention (verified algebraically); see correction 2 for terminals.

REMAINING WEAKNESSES (acknowledged in the material, verified as disclosed, not blocking): one-ply proxy vs full search (ladder step 5 covers); sibling probe n=12/cell with random alternatives; control n=15 power (~18% upper bound, midgame n=24 supplements); m4c12 evaluated mid-recovery (loss 3.36 by ep13). One small replication nuance: on the random (non-stratified) fresh sample the healthy heads BEAT the [0,5) MAE<=15 bar (9.9-10.9) and m3c7 pairwise hits 0.910 — the probe's length-stratified sampling made its "fails the strict bar" framing conservative, so the QUALIFIED-NO/coarse-signal verdict is if anything understated in the head's favor; verdict unchanged.

Verifier artifacts: E:\Hexo-BotTrainer-hexgt\scripts\_wf_s3v_rederive.py, _wf_s3v_rederive_out.txt, _wf_s3v_freshaudit.py, _wf_s3v_freshaudit_out.txt (CPU-only, read-only, live run untouched).
required_corrections: UNIT AMBIGUITY (design L0 item 1 + risk bullet 8 + dawdle-probe caveat 4): rewrite as RESOLVED-NO-MISMATCH. Measured: ml + turn_index == L-1 for 100% of unmasked rows (union of source-epoch decisive .hxr lengths; shuffleddata mixes an epoch window, explaining npz max 860 vs own-epoch 855). npz targets are decisions-remaining-after in PLACEMENT units, identical to samples.py, the .hxr replay convention, and the proposed Rust depth-offset units ('decisions' = placements; the dense trajectory includes fast/init moves, selfplay.py:912-916; formula unchanged since commit 80c48cc). Drop 'head retrained on consistent units BEFORE enablement' — wasted work; keep at most a cheap one-time assertion/telemetry. The 'sum == game length exactly / plies-like / ~2x mis-scale' wording is factually wrong.

TERMINAL LEAF OFFSET (design L3 / utility_design): 'handles terminals EXACTLY (ml = 0 + path distance)' is off by one — under the after-decision convention a terminal leaf should contribute (path_len - i - 1), not (path_len - i), because terminal states make no decision (NN and existing-node leaves are exact as specified). Magnitude trivial (1 decision = 1/8 bin) but either use offset-1 for terminals or document the +1 bias instead of claiming exactness.

WORST-CASE SAFETY ARGUMENT (utility_design calibration paragraph): 'tanh cap 0.03 < healthy-control median v-gap 0.065 so healthy choices cannot flip even in the worst case' is logically invalid — 6/15 control gaps are < 0.03 (min 0.0049, three with the runner-up at lower ml) and the differential bonus between two edges can reach 2*w_ml = 0.06. The conclusion survives on the empirical evidence instead (0/15 control flips through k=1.0, min finite control critical-k ~17, realistic sibling deltaM ~5 units -> differential bonus ~0.005): replace the median-gap worst-case claim with the measured-margin argument.

COSMETIC NUMBER ERRORS (probe 2 summary/key_numbers): (a) 'ml_base 9.8 -> successor ml ~21, median +25 jump' is garbled — actual control ml_base median 21.4 (9.8 is the minimum), successors ~46-50; the +25 per-candidate median jump itself is correct (re-derived +24.9) and the same-parity-only conclusion stands. (b) 'head marathon accuracy r=-0.03, MAE 126, bias -81' is the m3c5-on-m3ep9 OVERALL aggregate, not the marathon [120+) bucket (which is worse: MAE 177, bias -176, r -0.105); label it accordingly — direction of the argument unaffected.
